title: Researcher's archive destroyed by his widow, part kept by his daughter

tellings.quote: and she herself says that her stepmother destroyed all the material and she still has a part of the material.

plain: After a Brazilian UFO researcher died, his widow destroyed his archive, but his daughter, Claudia Kovu, kept part of it. Carlos de Souza, who has looked into the 1996 Varginha case, tells Michels what Kovu herself says: 'her stepmother destroyed all the material and she still has a part of the material.' If true, much of what the researcher gathered, including his recordings, may be gone for good.
